title: How would you advise I go about finding someone to pay to help me with my game?
author: Sometimes_good_ideas
selftext: I’m not looking for applicants from this sub I’m just wondering how I should start thinking about this. I have a game that I’m making just for me that I plan to eventually release for free but there’s certain aspects that I just can’t make work alone and I want to find and pay someone to help out. I have a pretty healthy disposable income. I was thinking the best option would be someone overseas? Any advice here would help. Thanks!

replies.author: Sometimes_good_ideas
replies.body: Yeah that was my first thought too, and very likely what I’ll end up doing but I’m curious what other paths I can explore. Thanks for your comment!

comments.author: Kayaba_Attribution
comments.body: reddit will prob be a good place, another would be uni clubs

replies.author: Sometimes_good_ideas
replies.body: I love Reddit, so many talented and friendly people so definitely I think that’s a good idea. I went to Virginia Tech so that’s a great idea too, lots of talented folks out there. Great advice, thanks for your comment!

comments.author: playtetramental
comments.body: Depends on what you're asking for help for? I've seen jobs posted on job sites for contractor-type positions if that's what you're looking for. If it's art or music, ask in those channels/sites.

replies.author: Sometimes_good_ideas
replies.body: Right now I’m struggling the most with characters and animations, what should I search to find contractors like you’ve seen? Thanks for your comment!

replies.author: Sometimes_good_ideas
replies.body: Amazing, this is very helpful thank you!

comments.author: FrozenFirebat
comments.body: You could also describe your problem and perhaps one of us have an idea on a solution. It could just be a communication issue between you and your agent if you don't know the right language.

replies.author: Sometimes_good_ideas
replies.body: It’s the 3d character design and animations, I have seen a similar issue in some other games here so I assumed it’s a thing Claude just can’t do yet, maybe I should wait for fable 3 or the nvidia tools to improve?

replies.author: FrozenFirebat
replies.body: Depends on what you're making. If its humanoid, kimodo can typically do whatever you need... or you can use unreal 5.9 with kimodo. If its the character, chatgpt can make images and use messy to turn them into decent 3d models. Its non humanoid animations that still are problematic

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body: I have taken gigs from redditors before. dm me for more detail

comments.author: Guildbound
comments.body: I would ask some of the Thailand AI devs they make some pretty sick games

comments.author: TalkingPixelsStudio
comments.body:
I can help with most things including getting a prototype going. All I ask in return is using my platforms tools (if it suits you) don't have to use all but im really struggling to get enough users for testing lol.
